mapper.select: SELECT mq.id, mq.member_email, mq.quest_id, mq.status, mq.assigned_date, mq.due_date, mq.completed_at, mq.created_by, mq.profile_id, q.title, q.description, q.type, q.difficulty, q.theme, q.reward, q.urgency, q.due_days FROM tbl_member_quest mq JOIN tbl_quest q ON mq.quest_id = q.quest_id WHERE mq.id = #{id} AND mq.member_email = #{email}
SELECT quest_id, title, description, type, difficulty, theme, reward, urgency, due_days, active FROM tbl_quest WHERE type = 'DAILY' AND active = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_member_quest (member_email, quest_id, status, assigned_date, due_date, created_by, profile_id) VALUES (#{memberEmail}, #{questId}, #{status}, #{assignedDate}, #{dueDate}, #{createdBy}, #{profileId})
mapper.update: ALTER TABLE tbl_member_quest ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS profile_id BIGINT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_quest (title, description, type, repeat_type, difficulty, theme, reward, urgency, due_days, active) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{type}, #{type}, #{difficulty}, #{theme}, #{reward}, #{urgency}, #{dueDays}, #{active})
mapper.select: SELECT q.quest_id, q.title, q.description, q.type, q.difficulty, q.theme, q.reward, q.urgency, q.due_days, q.active FROM tbl_quest q WHERE q.type = 'DAILY' AND q.active = TRUE AND q.quest_id NOT IN ( SELECT mq.quest_id FROM tbl_member_quest mq JOIN tbl_quest q2 ON mq.quest_id = q2.quest_id WHERE mq.member_email = #{email} AND mq.assigned_date = #{date} AND q2.type = 'DAILY' AND mq.profile_id IS NOT NULL AND mq.profile_id <> #{profileId} AND mq.quest_id IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{rowCount}
